• Generate Correlation ID (C_ID)
• Registers CompletableFuture<T>
• Immediately returns to caller

• Dequeues Command Message
• Extracts C_ID and Return Address (reply_to)
• Commits Business Transaction

• Sends to dynamic queue specified in reply_to
